speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this dry cough going on for about three months now. It doesn't bring up any phlegm or blood, but it makes me feel quite winded when I try to play basketball. However, a mandatory quality audit requires a final diagnosis label to be logged at this point in the consultation.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
